visible_highlights: Low-top mesh lace-up casual shoes with patterned upper openings and a thick sole profile. The side-panel outline and heel pull loop add visible structure to the knit-like mesh appearance. Mesh lining and an EVA midsole are specified, with Black and Beige choices through EU 39–48.
visible_faq_text: FAQs Which color and EU size choices are listed? Beige: EU 39–48; Black: EU 39–48. How is the mesh upper arranged? Patterned openings sit between the toe and side panels, with a conventional lace-up front and heel pull loop. The shoe has mesh lining and an EVA midsole. What should I assess on a sample? Adjust the laces with the intended socks, then check toe room, instep fit and heel hold before choosing the bulk EU size mix. What is the minimum order for the original style? The listed original-style minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; logo and custom packaging proposals are quoted separately. How can I request a sample? Send the selected color, EU size and delivery postcode for a sample quotation covering the pair, courier charge and proposed dispatch date. What should I send for logo or packaging requirements? Send the logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. The proposal for this style will set out the applicable minimum, cost and sample process. How can I get a delivered quotation? Send pair quantities by color and EU size, the destination postcode or port and the packaging request. The quotation separates product cost and freight and includes the proposed dispatch and transit schedule.
